Hi Alicia and Tom —

Following our quick intro last week, thanks for taking a look at MedOptics as a candidate for the ACE program. MedOptics is evaluating Redwood for an inference platform footprint across their imaging product lines; they are interested in the AWS marketplace route and would like co-sell support.

Attached: MedOptics-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan) and MedOptics-AWS-ACE-reqs.xlsx (ACE intake details).

Can you confirm the ACE registration path and who the assigned PDM/PSM will be on the AWS side? Proposed asks:
- Confirm ACE workspace/registration ID and expected review timeline
- PDM/PSM intro so we can align go-to-market motion and co-sell assets
- Any marketplace listing pre-reqs (SaaS listing, listing type, procurement notes) we should prioritize

Tom — could you confirm whether MedOptics procurement needs a sample SOW or a pricing worksheet up front? That will help us prioritize docs.

If it's helpful I can set a 30-minute alignment next week (internal+AWS+MedOptics) to lock the MAP and dates.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0132

- I'm the PDM handling this account on the AWS side; looping in Samir (PSM) for technical/partner enablement. Samir — can you pick a time for a PSM sync with Redwood and MedOptics?
- Marketplace pre-reqs: confirm listing type (SaaS vs AMI), EULA and commercial terms, and a short security checklist (SOC2/KMS notes). The ACE intake spreadsheet you sent looks good; I added one column for listing type.

Next steps I recommend:
1) 30-min triage with PDM/PSM/Redwood/MedOptics to align the MAP and dates
2) Samir to run a short tech readiness call (30–45m) to confirm integration points for billing and metering
3) Provide a pricing worksheet and draft SOW to MedOptics procurement (cc'd: Sara and Tom)

Looping Samir on thread.
